note: The variant register for the transcribed Isaiah blocks (PLAN.md §3, §5). Every word-level departure of the 1830 Book of Mormon text from the KJV, produced mechanically by tools/collate-isaiah.py and referenced by id from the `variants` field of the Link for each verse. Punctuation and capitalization are not collated; the KJV's italics are not marked in the public-domain source text used here (text/SOURCES.md), so the standing question of whether these departures cluster at italicized words CANNOT be answered from this register as it stands, and no claim about it is made.

kinds.replace: The Book of Mormon reads differently where the KJV has words.
kinds.omit: The KJV has words the Book of Mormon does not.
kinds.add: The Book of Mormon has words the KJV does not.
